221.title: [OCM P0][#197] Theory-base hardening and breakthrough-candidate feasibility — parent subtraction before proof freeze
221.body:
Parent: #197 (execution checklist)  
Umbrella: #194  
Active draft: #226

**Status: P0 THEORY-HARDENING CHILD. NO NOVELTY OR BREAKTHROUGH CLAIM.**

This child owns the first coherent executable cluster rather than letting multiple sessions edit the master issue directly.

## Scope

- repository/custody snapshot and import-authority audit;
- strongest-parent source-card protocol and comparator matrix;
- formal semantics/resource-calculus feasibility;
- early parent-collapse attack;
- feasibility of Verified-Trace Learnability, Warranted Lifecycle Learning, Warrant Lift and authority-indexed representation residuals.

## Deliverables

- [ ] `research/orion-machine/README.md`
- [ ] `research/orion-machine/OCM_SNAPSHOT_V1.json`
- [ ] `research/orion-machine/OCM_TASK_LEDGER_V1.json`
- [ ] `research/orion-machine/OCM_FAILURE_LEDGER.md`
- [ ] parent-source protocol and parent-atlas seed
- [ ] strongest-parent product and parity comparator
- [ ] theorem/falsifier register
- [ ] lifecycle-identifiability, Warranted Lifecycle Learning, Warrant Lift and strict-interface theorem artifacts
- [ ] exact finite checkers with planted failures
- [ ] independent hostile review stating which candidates collapse and what exact residual remains

## Required findings

1. State whether the whole OCM computation can be simulated by a recurrent/looped Transformer plus equally provisioned memory, verifier and tools. If yes, record that expressivity alone cannot be the novelty axis.
2. State whether each counting, partition, recourse or certificate bound is already a standard information/data-structure/logic result. Preserve parent-owned outcomes.
3. State whether trace/support gains arise only because extra information or privileged labels were supplied. Count every acquisition, closure and verifier bit.
4. Identify one candidate theorem combining lower bound, upper construction and ORION-native reliability/authority obligations without hiding work in the verifier.
5. Compare current-behavior equivalence with lifecycle equivalence under evidence/scope/authority/verifier updates.
6. Treat missing positive support as unknown, never as proof of absence, unless a scope/epoch-bound closure certificate exists.

## Gates

- no abstract-only load-bearing source claims;
- no source card without exact assumptions and non-consequence;
- no candidate advances without strongest-parent product comparison;
- every negative finding remains in the failure ledger;
- same-session theorem authorship cannot close the independent review issue #199;
- child closes with `CANDIDATE_SURVIVES_FOR_PROOF_FREEZE`, `PARENT_SUFFICIENT`, `REFORMULATE`, or exact `CANNOT_CHECK`.

No protected outcomes or model training are authorized by this child.

## Administrative correction

Earlier text named #195 as parent. Repository number #195 is a closed audit pull request, not the OCM execution master. Canonical execution authority is #197. This correction grants no scientific authority.

197.title: [ORION MACHINE EXECUTION][#194] Atomic checklist for theory hardening, breakthrough theorem search, mechanization and AI handoff
197.body:
## Status

**EXECUTION MASTER FOR #194 — THEORY HARDENING AND BREAKTHROUGH SEARCH.**

No claim that ORION is a new model class, replaces Transformers, needs fewer parameters, learns language with less data, or gains quantum advantage is earned by opening this issue. A checked box means its stated acceptance test is satisfied by a linked merged artifact or an explicitly recorded adverse/CANNOT_CHECK terminal. It never means the overall programme succeeded.

Parent umbrella: #194  
Framework parents: #48, #49, #50  
Quantum parents: `SzeChunYiu/ORION#679`, `#698`, `#903`, `#908`  
Paper-method parent: `SzeChunYiu/academic-paper-skills`

---

# 1. Mission and strongest current hypothesis

The programme is not allowed to win by renaming recurrence, external memory, program search, process supervision, abstract interpretation, or proof-carrying computation.

The strongest currently surviving **conjecture bundle** is:

> A finite-description, shared recurrent cognitive core may require materially less immutable learned capacity on selected compositional task families when it can (i) acquire reusable operators from locally verifiable computational traces, (ii) choose query-relative representations carrying machine-checkable sufficiency/authority scopes, (iii) use mutable memory and adaptive computation, and (iv) preserve proof/evidence obligations across state updates.

The intended mathematical object is provisionally an **ORION Cognitive Machine (OCM)**. The name is disposable. If the strongest faithful parent product owns the object, route to `PARENT_SUFFICIENT`, rename/contract, and preserve the result.

The first publication-worthy target is not Turing completeness. It is one of:

1. a strict finite-description/sample/communication trade-off theorem against a precisely registered comparator;
2. a learnability separation for **verified local traces** versus endpoint-only observations;
3. a representation theorem for **query-relative certified abstractions** plus minimal reopening under criterion change;
4. a negative theorem showing that the strongest recurrent-Transformer/memory/verifier parent simulates the proposed OCM without a meaningful asymptotic or finite-resource residual.

A rigorous negative is a successful outcome.

---

# 2. Expert cells and non-voting responsibilities

Every load-bearing finding must receive at least two independent cells: one constructive and one hostile.

- **X1 — complexity / lower bounds:** circuit complexity, streaming, communication, branching programs, cell-probe/data-structure bounds, advice/description complexity.
- **X2 — neural architecture / learning:** Transformers, recurrent/looped Transformers, SSMs, adaptive depth, modular routing, test-time learning.
- **X3 — formal methods:** operational semantics, simulation/refinement, proof assistants, model checking, certifying algorithms, countermodels.
- **X4 — learning and information theory:** sample complexity, identifiability, MDL/Kolmogorov caveats, traces, process supervision, corrupted supervision.
- **X5 — language / cognition:** grammar, parsing/generation, semantics, compositional generalization, memory systems, cognitive architectures.
- **X6 — ORION epistemics:** evidence, authority, provenance, dependence, receipts, reconciliation, scoped reopening, failure knowledge.
- **X7 — quantum complexity:** query models, state preparation/oracle cost, fault tolerance, measurement/error, classical simulation controls.
- **X8 — hostile parent / novelty referee:** attempts to reduce every primitive and theorem to the strongest parent or parent composition.
- **X9 — publication / reproducibility:** atomic-claim ledger, protocol/conduct state, source verification, paper-admission and venue-fit gates.

No vote or consensus licenses a claim. Each cell produces arguments, witnesses, counterexamples, and a disposition.

---

# 3. Checkbox protocol for AI sessions

## 3.1 Claiming work

An AI session must:

- [ ] `OPS-001` Read the latest #194, this issue, #48/#49/#50, linked open PRs, and the machine-readable backlog before selecting work.
- [ ] `OPS-002` Select the earliest unchecked task whose dependencies are all complete; post a short claim comment containing `TASK_ID`, base SHA, branch name, intended artifacts, and collision check.
- [ ] `OPS-003` Re-check that no active PR/session owns the same task or files. Do not overwrite concurrent work.
- [ ] `OPS-004` Use a fresh branch. Frozen/protected artifacts are read-only unless the task explicitly creates a successor identity.
- [ ] `OPS-005` Keep adverse, null, parent-sufficient, contradiction, and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes. Never retune a theorem statement after seeing a counterexample without preserving the failed version.

## 3.2 Checking a box

A task may be checked only when a comment records:

```text
TASK_ID:
STATUS: PASS | REFUTED | PARENT_SUFFICIENT | CANNOT_CHECK | SUPERSEDED
BASE_SHA:
PR_OR_COMMIT:
ARTIFACTS:
PRIMARY_SOURCES:
COMMANDS_AND_EXIT_CODES:
HOSTILE_CONTROLS:
RESULT:
NON_CONSEQUENCES:
AUTHORITY_DELTA:
NEXT_TASK:
```

- [ ] `OPS-006` Every PASS includes a planted failure or counterexample showing the checker/proof obligation can fail.
- [ ] `OPS-007` Every zero count reports the evaluated denominator.
- [ ] `OPS-008` Every proof states precision, uniformity, input/access model, resource measure, quantifiers, and comparator class.
- [ ] `OPS-009` Machine-checked proof is not enough: independently audit whether assumptions encode the conclusion.
- [ ] `OPS-010` A finite exhaustive oracle is a sanity/counterexample instrument, not an all-size proof unless the theorem domain is itself finite.
- [ ] `OPS-011` Do not check a parent task merely because a source was cited; reconstruct the exact result and its boundary.
- [ ] `OPS-012` Update the machine-readable backlog and issue checkbox in the same PR/comment after acceptance, never before.

## 3.3 Exit discipline

Valid programme terminals:

- `BREAKTHROUGH_THEOREM_CANDIDATE`
- `REGIME_LIMITED_SEPARATION`
- `TRADEOFF_FRONTIER_ONLY`
- `PARENT_SUFFICIENT`
- `TRANSFORMER_EQUIVALENT_UNDER_MATCHED_RESOURCES`
- `FORMALISM_USEFUL_NO_ARCHITECTURE_RESIDUAL`
- `LANGUAGE_BRIDGE_UNSUPPORTED`
- `QUANTUM_BACKEND_NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE`
- `CANNOT_CHECK`
- `PROGRAMME_REFRAMED_BY_STRONGER_OBJECT`

No issue or AI session may emit `REVOLUTIONARY`, `TRANSFORMER_REPLACED`, `AGI`, `NOVEL`, or `TOP_TIER_READY` as a scientific terminal.

---

# 4. WP0 — executable programme spine

**Deliverables:** `research/orion-machine/` with human and machine twins; schema; validator; event ledger; CI; failure ledger.

- [ ] `OM-WP0-001` Create `research/orion-machine/CORE.md` with authority, current status, owners, dependency map, and start-here instructions.
  - Acceptance: every artifact below is indexed; no result claim is implied.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-002` Create `OCM_EXECUTION_BACKLOG_V1.json`.
  - Must encode task id, description, dependencies, owner cell, artifacts, status, evidence, terminal, and reopen conditions.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-003` Create JSON Schema for the backlog.
  - Acceptance: shipped backlog validates; invalid status, dangling dependency, duplicate id, checked-without-evidence, and cyclic-dependency fixtures fail for the right reason.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-004` Build a validator with exit `0=valid`, `1=defect`, `2=cannot-check`.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-005` Add a hash-chained JSONL event ledger for task claims, status transitions, theorem revisions, refutations, and supersessions.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-006` Add a chained verifier runner and CI workflow.
  - It must report PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED/CANNOT_CHECK per check.
  - Missing optional proof-tool dependencies must never become PASS.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-007` Create `OCM_FAILURE_AND_NEGATIVE_LEDGER_V1.md`.
  - Seed with every killed/contracted claim from §6.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-008` Create source/version custody rules and a current-main snapshot receipt.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-009` Add hostile fixtures proving the spine catches false green, empty denominator, stale evidence pointer, proof hash drift, and unrecorded theorem-statement mutation.
- [ ] `OM-WP0-010` Independent second-session review of WP0.
  - Acceptance: reviewer works from immutable artifacts without receiving a pre-adjudicated concern list.

**WP0 gate:** all ten tasks complete, or exact `CANNOT_CHECK` blockers recorded. No theorem lane begins on an unverifiable programme state.

---

# 5. WP1 — strongest-parent saturation and novelty attack

Create `OCM_PARENT_THEORY_ATLAS_V1.md`, `OCM_PARENT_OWNERSHIP_CARDS_V1.json`, and a source ledger. Use primary sources for theorem/mechanism claims. Reviews/surveys may map the field but cannot own a theorem without checking the primary source.

For each lane below:

1. reconstruct at least the canonical parent and the strongest applicable current result;
2. state assumptions and exact theorem/algorithm;
3. implement or reproduce one native known-answer example where feasible;
4. record limitations and at least one counterexample/non-applicability case;
5. compare the strongest **composition** of parents, not only individual parents;
6. issue ownership cards for every colliding OCM primitive.

## WP1-A — Transformer and sequence-model theory

- [ ] `OM-WP1-A01` Standard encoder/decoder Transformer formal models: hard/soft attention, positional encodings, precision and uniformity.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A02` Formal-language and circuit-complexity upper/lower bounds for registered Transformer classes.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A03` Decoder-only Transformers with intermediate/generated computation steps.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A04` Universal, recurrent and looped Transformers; shared-weight depth.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A05` State-space/selective-state models and their relation to attention.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A06` Strongest composite comparator specification:
  `recurrent Transformer + same memory + same tools + same verifier + same adaptive-step budget`.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-A07` Hostile conclusion: enumerate which proposed separations disappear under A06.

## WP1-B — memory, programs and adaptive computation

- [ ] `OM-WP1-B01` Neural Turing Machines, Differentiable Neural Computers, memory networks and fast-weight/test-time memory.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-B02` Retrieval-augmented models and parameter–datastore trade-offs; count index, storage, bandwidth and retrieval.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-B03` Program interpreters, universal circuits, algorithm selection, CEGIS and verifier-guided synthesis.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-B04` Adaptive computation time, early exit, test-time scaling and inverse-scaling/stopping failures.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-B05` Sparse/MoE/modular routing and conditional computation.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-B06` Strongest parent product and exact residual, if any.

## WP1-C — traces, learning and compositionality

- [ ] `OM-WP1-C01` Identification in the limit with computational traces.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-C02` Learning/program synthesis from execution traces, demonstrations, parse trees and privileged/process supervision.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-C03` Learning finite automata/transducers and compositional operator libraries.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-C04` Corrupted, partial, adversarial or self-authored traces; verifier independence.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-C05` Sample/description complexity of endpoint-only versus trace-augmented learners.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-C06` Strongest parent product and exact residual, if any.

## WP1-D — representations, abstractions and query sufficiency

- [ ] `OM-WP1-D01` Minimal sufficient statistics, Blackwell/decision sufficiency and task-relative information.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D02` Partition/quotient lattices and formal concept/Galois structure.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D03` Abstract interpretation, refinement, CEGAR and proof-carrying abstractions.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D04` Data structures, cell-probe/communication lower bounds and query-dependent encoding.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D05` Incremental computation, dependency tracking, truth-maintenance and minimal invalidation/reopening.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D06` Information bottleneck and task-specific learned representations.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-D07` Strongest parent product and exact residual, if any.

## WP1-E — verification, evidence and cognitive architectures

- [ ] `OM-WP1-E01` Certifying algorithms, proof-carrying code/data, interactive/probabilistic verification and authenticated structures.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-E02` Formal runtime monitors, refinement types, theorem-prover agents and proof-producing computation.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-E03` Truth-maintenance, belief revision, provenance semirings and dependency-aware retraction.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-E04` SOAR/ACT-R/global-workspace/production-system and blackboard cognitive architectures.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-E05` Scientific-workflow/agent architectures with memory, tools, reflection and verification.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-E06` Strongest parent product and exact residual, if any.

## WP1-F — quantum substrate

- [ ] `OM-WP1-F01` Classical/quantum query complexity for each proposed operator.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-F02` State preparation, oracle construction, readout, error and fault-tolerance costs.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-F03` Classical simulation/dequantization and NISQ-boundary controls.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-F04` Map to existing ORION-Q state/resource/authority contracts; create no parallel vocabulary.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-F05` Identify at least one operator with a genuine conditional separation or record `NO_ELIGIBLE_OPERATOR_YET`.

## Saturation and changed-vocabulary checks

- [ ] `OM-WP1-S01` Reverse ancestry from every OCM primitive to its strongest parent.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-S02` Search under at least eight vocabulary remints:
  `adaptive controller`, `recurrent program`, `proof-carrying memory`, `query-relative abstraction`, `certified state machine`, `process-supervised learner`, `cognitive architecture`, `interactive resource-bounded learner`.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-S03` Hostile “old wine” review by X8.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-S04` Strongest-parent **composition** constructed and compared.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-S05` Three post-material-addition full passes add no new load-bearing parent, theorem, obstruction or contraction.
- [ ] `OM-WP1-S06` Every surviving conjecture has an ownership card; every killed conjecture enters the negative ledger.

**WP1 gate:** novelty status remains `OPEN` until S01–S06 complete. If the parent product owns all candidate contributions, route to `PARENT_SUFFICIENT` and write the negative/equivalence paper plan.

---

# 6. WP2 — critical triage: claims to kill before formalization

These are provisional kill targets. A task checks when the claim is formally withdrawn/contracted with evidence—not when it is made true.

- [ ] `OM-WP2-001` Kill `TURING_COMPLETENESS_IMPLIES_SUPERIORITY`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-002` Kill `RECURRENCE_ALONE_IS_NOVEL`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-003` Kill `EXTERNAL_MEMORY_REMOVES_INFORMATION_COST`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-004` Kill `FEWER_NEURONS_IS_A_WELL_DEFINED_THEOREM` without finite precision/description.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-005` Kill `GRAMMAR_ALONE_EXPLAINS_FRONTIER_LANGUAGE_CAPABILITY`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-006` Kill `SEMANTIC_COMPILER_IS_FREE_OR_ORACLE_CORRECT`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-007` Kill `VERIFIER_COST_OR_PRIVILEGE_CAN_BE_IGNORED`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-008` Kill `MORE_TEST_TIME_COMPUTE_MONOTONICALLY_HELPS`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-009` Kill `FORMAL_LANGUAGE_WIN_IMPLIES_GENERAL_LANGUAGE_INTELLIGENCE`.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-010` Kill classical uses of quantum vocabulary as evidence of quantum computation.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-011` Kill universal “OCM beats every Transformer” claims by no-free-lunch/comparator construction.
- [ ] `OM-WP2-012` Publish a contraction table: original ambition → defensible theorem target → falsifier.

---

# 7. WP3 — formal OCM semantics

Artifacts: `OCM_OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS_V1.md`, machine schema, executable finite reference semantics, tests, and later proof-assistant definitions.

Provisional machine:

`OCM = (X,S,M,G,E,A,Theta,delta,rho,V,H,R)`

- [ ] `OM-WP3-001` Define observations, tasks/goals/obligations and output/action semantics.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-002` Define finite-description immutable core `Theta`; prohibit analog infinite-information weights.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-003` Separate working, semantic, episodic and procedural memory by interface—not metaphor.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-004` Define shared recurrent transition `delta` and state invariants.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-005` Define parser/renderer `rho`; its description, training and errors count as part of the machine.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-006` Define verifier/challenge `V`, its information boundary, soundness/completeness and cost.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-007` Define halting/routing `H`, including abstention and inverse-scaling hostiles.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-008` Define evidence/provenance/authority state `E` and dependency semantics.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-009` Define deterministic, randomized and optional nondeterministic variants.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-010` Define exact symbolic versus approximate neural state and conversion error.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-011` Define classical probability/branching separately from genuine quantum state.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-012` Give small nontrivial machines: conversation transducer, stack task, verified search, memory update, representation reopening.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-013` Give degenerate/adversarial machines showing why each side condition is needed.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-014` Implement a finite reference interpreter with trace/receipt output.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-015` Independent semantics review and parent-reduction attempt.
- [ ] `OM-WP3-016` Freeze V1 only after statement hash, examples, hostiles and review are bound.

---

# 8. WP4 — whole-system resource theory

Artifacts: `OCM_RESOURCE_CONTRACT_V1.md`, schema, calculator/checker, comparator manifests.

Use at least:

`R = (B_theta, B_static, B_mut_peak, B_mut_total, T_seq, W_total, IO, BW, V_cost, train_cost, Q_resource, energy_if_valid)`

- [ ] `OM-WP4-001` Define finite bit/precision model.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-002` Define immutable learned parameters versus immutable program/library bits.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-003` Define peak and cumulative mutable memory.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-004` Define sequential depth/time and total parallel work.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-005` Define external I/O, retrieval index and bandwidth/communication.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-006` Define verifier/proof/checker cost and information privilege.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-007` Define training/data acquisition/amortization accounting.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-008` Define quantum query/gate/ancilla/error resources only when applicable.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-009` Define worst-case, average-case, distributional and amortized comparisons.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-010` Define Pareto dominance and hard non-compensatory violations.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-011` Prove/verify “no disappearing resource under representation move.”
- [ ] `OM-WP4-012` Produce matched manifests for:
  fixed-depth Transformer; recurrent Transformer; SSM; NTM/DNC; retrieval model; OCM.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-013` Add laundering hostiles: free database, free parser, free verifier, free preprocessing, uncounted intermediate tokens, infinite precision, stronger oracle.
- [ ] `OM-WP4-014` Independent accounting audit.

---

# 9. WP5 — breakthrough-candidate tournament

No candidate proceeds because it sounds ORION-like. Each must beat its strongest parent formulation on a registered theorem object.

## Candidate A — Verified Trace Learnability (primary)

Provisional question:

> Do locally checkable, proof-carrying transition traces yield a strict learnability/sample/description-complexity advantage over endpoint-only observations for a natural compositional machine/language class, under bounded verifier cost and partial/adversarial trace corruption?

- [ ] `OM-WP5-A01` Define a natural task/language/transducer family and endpoint-only learner class.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A02` Define trace objects, local certificates, verifier access and corruption model.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A03` Prove endpoint-only lower bound or non-identifiability.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A04` Prove verified-trace upper bound.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A05` Count trace length, certificate bits and verifier work.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A06` Prove robustness or exact failure threshold under missing/corrupt/self-authored traces.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A07` Compare directly with the strongest computational-trace/program-learning parent.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A08` Demonstrate the verifier does not encode the target program/labels.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A09` Mechanize the finite core theorem(s) and independently review assumptions.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-A10` State exactly what this does **not** prove about English/frontier LLMs.

## Candidate B — Authority-Indexed Representation Lattice

Provisional question:

> Can a machine choose the coarsest representation certified sufficient for the current query/obligation and obtain a strict active-state or communication advantage over any single representation that must preserve all registered queries, while minimally reopening state when the query or authority scope changes?

- [ ] `OM-WP5-B01` Define worlds, query families, answer/verifier relations and representation sufficiency.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B02` Construct the quotient/partition lattice and prove minimal sufficient objects exist under stated finiteness conditions.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B03` Define authority/scope certificates and sound use rule.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B04` Prove a nontrivial lower bound for any single all-query representation.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B05` Prove an adaptive query-relative upper bound including routing/access cost.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B06` Prove selective reopening soundness and minimality after query/criterion change.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B07` Attack with sufficient statistics, abstract interpretation, data structures and communication parents.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B08` Compare against a recurrent Transformer with identical memory/query access.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B09` Provide an incompatible-partition witness family and finite exhaustive checker.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-B10` State whether the result is architecture-neutral, OCM-specific, or parent-owned.

## Candidate C — Core–Memory–Time–Verification frontier

- [ ] `OM-WP5-C01` Define `C_core^*(F; m,t,v,io,p)` as minimum finite immutable description for task family `F` under resource bounds.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C02` Prove existence/monotonicity/basic inequalities without hiding noncomputability.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C03` Select at least two natural task families with known lower-bound machinery.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C04` Derive OCM upper bounds.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C05` Derive strongest registered comparator lower bounds.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C06` Characterize when memory/time/verifier substitutions are strict versus mere relocation.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C07` Give a frontier or impossibility result, not one cherry-picked point.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C08` Attack using universal simulation/advice/branching-program parents.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C09` Mechanize finite lemmas and independently audit asymptotic proof.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-C10` Report full-system resource vectors for every claimed separation.

## Candidate D — Proof-Carrying Cognitive State and minimal reconciliation

- [ ] `OM-WP5-D01` Formalize claims, dependencies, evidence, authority and expiry as state.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D02` Define locally certified state transitions and adversarial writes.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D03` Prove global live-claim invariant by induction.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D04` Prove selective reopening soundness.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D05` Prove minimality under a stated dependency model or record counterexample.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D06` Handle verifier uncertainty, dependence and stale authority.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D07` Compare with TMS, incremental proof checking, build systems and authenticated data structures.
- [ ] `OM-WP5-D08` Determine whether this is a standalone theorem, OCM subsystem, or parent composition.

## Tournament gate

- [ ] `OM-WP5-G01` Freeze candidate statements before decisive counterexample/proof runs.
